# The contract packages (docs/server/architecture.md "Contract packages"): types, constants and trivial pure helpers only.
# Each imports only the standard library and other packages of this list. A new contract package goes here; a
# package named *wire must be listed (the test checks), other contracts (nodeproto, proto, relayproto, rpc) are listed
# by hand: proxyproto, say, is a protocol implementation, not a contract. The SDK's wire types (generated from the
# protocol's schema, another module) are named by their full import path.
internal/aiwire
internal/assistantwire
internal/connectorwire
internal/devicewire
internal/dialogwire
internal/extwire
internal/kbwire
internal/nodeproto
internal/proto
internal/relayproto
internal/rpc
github.com/nwverse/persona/sdk/go/wire
